body:
Fine Experience
Received 3 nuts in the mail. Couldn't get my hands on slaked lime, it being December and all. Used about 1/8 teaspoon sodium bicarbonate instead. Moistened nut overnight in water to soften. Cut into halves. Wrapped 1 half in lemon zest and cinnamon and chewed until softish, more woody than anything. Then took the sodium bicarbonate.
Mild euphoria, mental and physical stimulation. Got a lot of house work done. It would seem the sodium bicarbonate is a passable substitute for agricultural slaked lime.
